prompt:
Create NEW animation art for our chibi Slayer, using reference 1 as the authoritative character DESIGN, reference 2 as the existing chibi body sheet for SCALE/ANATOMY, and reference 3 ONLY for weight shift and sword-swing body mechanics. This is a recreation in OUR approved CHIBI PIXEL STYLE, not a recolor or resizing of the tall DFO sprites.

Output a SQUARE transparent sprite sheet, exactly SIX COLUMNS by SIX ROWS, 36 equal square cells, ideally 1536x1536 (256px cells). No grid lines, text, drop shadows, backgrounds or weapons. Every frame is the same small character scale, roughly 70% cell height, centered with feet on an identical baseline at 86% cell height. Keep the whole character within its cell. Actual transparent background.

DESIGN LOCK: big head and short body, tall cream-blond angular hair crown, navy side locks, glossy rectangular cobalt-blue forehead guard WITHOUT trailing ribbons; serious red eyes; navy feather shoulder trim and open vest with ivory lapels; bare torso and small gold pendant; blue trousers with bold ivory diagonal panels, brown belt; navy boots with ivory panels and GREEN ankle rings; anatomical LEFT arm is crimson-magenta with green inset silver wrist cuff and hanging chain; normal anatomical RIGHT arm has gray bracer. Do not change the costume or become tall. Strong consistent chunky pixel clusters, hard edges. No blurred shading. NO sword or equipment in either hand. Normal right fist will grip a separate sword.

Exact layout:
Row1: LEFT-facing idle, 6 distinct subtle breathing frames, fixed feet, shoulders rise then fall, wrist moves with torso, consistent head.
Row2: LEFT-facing WALK, 6 genuinely DIFFERENT cyclic poses: contact LEFT leg ahead / recoil / passing / contact RIGHT leg ahead / recoil / passing. Leg strides and arm swings alternate clearly; not 6 duplicate stances. Preserve same size. Do not alternate facing.
Row3: LEFT-facing right-arm basic SWORD-SWING BODY motion (empty hand), 6 strong poses: (1) draw right arm back with weight on rear foot, (2) raise normal RIGHT fist over head for anticipation, (3) step forward and extend right fist toward LEFT across chest for impact, (4) extend normal right arm down-left following through, (5) recover fist toward hip while straightening, (6) settle to initial guard. Cursed arm balances. Only normal right arm attacks.
Row4: RIGHT-facing idle 6 frames corresponding to row1, independently authored with correct anatomy.
Row5: RIGHT-facing WALK 6 frames corresponding to row2, genuinely alternate legs and arm movement.
Row6: RIGHT-facing sword-swing body motion, same phases as row3 but attacking toward RIGHT with normal anatomical RIGHT arm.

ANATOMY: for left-facing frames the cursed anatomical LEFT arm is on the near viewer-right side, and normal RIGHT arm toward viewer-left. In right-facing frames the normal RIGHT arm is nearest viewer-right and cursed LEFT arm on far viewer-left. Never swap which anatomical arm is cursed. These two facings must be newly authored, NOT horizontal mirrors. Only TWO ARMS per frame. Keep gripping fists readable and away from face. All 36 frames are weapon-free.
correction: Edit this sprite sheet, preserving its transparent background, chibi pixel art design, number of frames and 6-column by 6-row arrangement. Fix exactly TWO facing mistakes: (1) ROW THREE, COLUMN SIX currently faces right; redraw it as a LEFT-facing recovery guard matching row3column1, with magenta cursed LEFT arm on viewer-right, normal gray-braced RIGHT hand forward at viewer-left. (2) ROW SIX, COLUMN TWO currently turns its face left while raising the right hand; redraw it to FACE RIGHT with its gray-braced normal RIGHT hand raised overhead on viewer-right, magenta anatomical LEFT arm balancing at viewer-left, matching row6's right-facing poses. Keep all other frames and costume intact. All characters remain empty-handed; no weapon. Keep complete feet/hair in every frame and transparent gaps. No text. Do not swap cursed anatomy. The six rows remain left idle, left walk, left attack, right idle, right walk, right attack.
